_about: Deterministic QC gate run after the brief and after the draft. Hard failures trigger one automatic repair pass; if they persist the task stays in its section with a QC comment. Soft findings are listed in the doc and the Asana comment.
banned_phrases: i hope this finds you well
at the end of the day

house_strip_outs.label: puts AI in the brand name
adds LLC to the brand name
writes the brand as one word
names hardware the approved list does not name

hard_failures: em dash anywhere in generated text
internal link target not in the live sitemap, or with a trailing slash
more than one H1, or a heading level skip (H1 to H3)
H1, title tag or meta description differ from the approved brief (draft stage)
soft_findings: title tag over 60 or meta description over 155 characters (code-counted)
banned phrase or banned CTA text
figure without a bracketed citation on the same line, or citations without a Sources list
exact-match anchors above 30% of internal links
primary keyword missing from title, H1, meta, first 100 words or every H2
word count outside the brief's target range
repeats another live draft's opening or closing line
